en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban and Muhammad Bin Yahya Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah having said: 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘When the man and the woman are both found to be in one quilt, and the proof is established upon them with that, and nothing else emerges from them both besides that, each one of them would be whipped one hundred lashes’.
